question: Classify B implementation ownership without confusing generic state with product orchestration.
procedure: Complete implementation body reads; reuse P28 evidence and existing source-resolved callbacks. Attach unchanged source hashes and eight-graph compile-command selection. Compile selection is not live runtime proof.
scope_limit: 49 C implementation files only; headers, full caller lifetimes and the four-component migration inventory remain incomplete. Retain decision concerns separately from body-read count.

rows.evidence: Calls native RtlDosPathNameToNtPathName_U without a modern relative-output structure; clears the caller's original output structure. No task lookup or outward provider.
rows.remaining: Historical necessity and selected original caller ABI remain governed by existing mirror evidence; no new equivalence test run.

rows.evidence: Combines the original low-bit handle predicate with GetConsoleMode and preserves LastError. No frontend selection or product protocol.

rows.decision: split native resource mechanics from product delivery; not independent today
rows.evidence: TLS binding dispatches Duplicate and Close to service_duplicate_resource/service_close_resource in src/ntsrv-exe/opennt/source/base_service.c. The latter resolve worker reservations, console-associated worker connections, stream receipts and parent/worker wait delivery. src/ntsrv-exe/opennt/include/base_server.h remaps NtDuplicateObject/NtClose to these B entrypoints for retained server code.
rows.state: Borrowed synchronous resource scope; prior TLS binding is restored by the F dispatch caller. Local unbound duplicate allows only current-process resources.
rows.migration: Keep handle operations with explicit resolved resources in B; retain authenticated reservation/recipient selection and request wait policy in F. Redesign the retained C operation boundary before replacing this dispatch. Simply moving provider bodies to B or using raw cross-process handles is rejected.
rows.remaining: Trace each retained C request operation, delivery and failure unwind to design an explicit non-callback execution boundary. Two additional source-resolved F callback slots, not new approved exceptions or closed ledger IDs.

rows.evidence: Owns bounded DOS/WOW command strings and borrowed immutable TLS configuration; no lookup or request selection. worker_registry.c selects product paths and binary kind, binds the configuration around BaseGetVdmConfigInfo, then restores the previous binding.
rows.contract: Caller retains configuration lifetime; preserve capacity failures and original reservation value. Do not migrate worker selection into this unit.

rows.decision: split/remove private F dispatch after provider migration
rows.evidence: Immutable 12-slot binding, providers resolved in s14-callback-provider-ownership.json.
rows.boundary: Capture buffers and selected-mode storage are mechanics; process creation and guest directory responsibilities require separate chains.

rows.decision: retain B native console cell-grid mechanics
rows.evidence: Reads and writes the supplied console handle, copies/clips cells on resize, frees temporary buffers and propagates incomplete transfer failure. No NTCON transport or session lookup.
Four functions call installed F code-page/layout/title providers.
rows.boundary: Do not substitute current-thread native queries for frontend-routed values without equivalence.

rows.evidence: demsrch.c captures and searches a filename/index hint using an explicit directory handle and native NtQueryDirectoryFile. No task or CPU state is consulted.
rows.contract: Preserve native enumeration status and caller-owned buffer lifetime. This review is ownership evidence, not a new proof of directory mutation semantics.

rows.decision: move machine providers to C; remove private F dispatch
rows.evidence: Four-slot immutable table for debug context/registers and protected-mode transitions.
rows.boundary: CPU/private descriptor and WOW page-domain operations are not generic B session mechanisms.

rows.evidence: Explicit MULTI_SZ root replacement and package-root ingress; heap/malloc ownership conversion without launch or task lookup.
rows.boundary: Preserve original environment separately; package layout is already owner-approved B capability.

rows.decision: split transport mechanics from existing C memory provider dependency
rows.evidence: Real-mode numeric location conversion, far reads and leases through current B host context.
rows.boundary: Lease operations still reach C SAS via guest_memory_lease; numerical independence is not runtime independence. Registration/epoch and failure behavior retained.

rows.decision: split memory staging from C provider access
rows.evidence: Current context, chunked lease copies and overlap-aware move; no F task lookup in bodies.
rows.boundary: Transitive C read/write dependency remains. Partial-copy and context closure behavior must survive complete-chain redesign.

rows.decision: split generic lease ownership from C SAS dispatch
rows.evidence: Owns bounce buffers, epochs and bounded slots; read/write callbacks resolve to C providers. Copy-only API holds SRW shared lock during provider call.
rows.boundary: Do not replace with reentrant SAS or raw memory; preserve failed-write release and end lifetime. Existing two C callbacks are not newly approved exceptions.

rows.decision: B minimal context mechanics with callback targets separately audited
rows.evidence: One TLS binding, registration flag and bounded reverse cleanup registry.
rows.boundary: Registry ownership does not make F cleanup bodies inward. F owns admission/disposal policy; no third session registry.

rows.decision: retain B explicit invariant failure primitive
rows.evidence: virtual.c supplies an invalid instance identifier. The function constructs a noncontinuable failure record and invokes native fail-fast; it does not select a task, cancel a session or complete a request.
rows.contract: Do not replace with session cancellation or a returning failure. Runtime fault behavior was not rerun.

rows.decision: no outward implementation; retained no-op requires separate necessity evidence
rows.evidence: Body is empty; references occur in nt_eoi.c and nt_unix.c. It does not delegate to a product scheduler.
rows.remaining: Symbol references and the ownership comment do not prove original idle semantics equivalent. Reconcile selected call paths and original responsibility before changing or claiming full semantic review.

rows.decision: no outward implementation; explicit unavailable ABI providers
rows.evidence: EDL_fast_bop, c_VirtualiseInstruction and c_sas_touch invoke __debugbreak; the latter two return zero if execution continues. C c_main.c references the BOP symbol; sascdef.c references the SAS entries.
rows.remaining: Do not describe debugbreak as guaranteed termination or restore unsupported machine algorithms into B. Selected vector reachability and historical unavailable-provider semantics still need reconciliation.

rows.evidence: Three ROM names map to resources in current image and copy to bounded caller buffer.
rows.boundary: Resource composition belongs to outer build; no guest execution, CPU algorithm or task policy here.

rows.decision: retain B bounded input metadata mechanism
rows.evidence: Uses caller-owned counters, ring metadata and opaque numeric receipts. C nt_event.c/keyba.c maintain hardware history; F console_compat.c stages and consumes receipts. B never resolves a receipt to a task or frontend.
rows.contract: Original keyboard lock must cover tags and device state; preserve overwritten-slot rejection and selected ages across reset. No second input or session state machine.

rows.decision: retain B finite registry view and file-overlay implementation; no session migration
rows.evidence: Read all 1723 lines: file baseline parser, bounded native HKLM snapshots, DOS-device serial discovery, opaque key handles, overlay/tombstone mutation, named-mutex commit, reload and cleanup. No Run16/NTSRV/NTCON/task-chain provider. F standalone worker initializes and shuts down; C cmdexec/obj.vdm and WOW callers consume B facades.
rows.state: Process-global file image, live key list, overlay list and commit mutex. Each open key owns its native snapshot. Writes reload under the mutex, replace the file and restore overlay on reported failure; shutdown releases all records and handle resources.
rows.boundary: Retain selected host-section restrictions and unsupported native query behavior. Do not widen registry access or reinterpret named writer mutex as synchronization for arbitrary readers/close/shutdown. F owns startup/stop timing. This ownership finding is not proof that parsing, sizing, concurrency and rollback are bug-free.
rows.tests: Existing test/mvdm-host/t461_registry_overlay_fixture.c contains restart, two-process writers and replacement-failure checks. It does not establish same-process concurrent read/close safety; no tests run in this source-only audit.
rows.remaining: Reconcile compile remaps and consumer shutdown/quiescence in full C call-chain audit. Do not add core session solely because this provider has state.

rows.decision: retain B native wait resource with explicit outer lifetime
rows.evidence: Owns one auto-reset event, signal/wait/create/close only. C c_main.c waits/signals; F mvdm_standalone_worker.c starts it before host execution and ends it after producer shutdown.
rows.contract: The single-execution-thread and stopped-producer lifetime is a caller precondition, not internally synchronized teardown. Do not convert it to a scheduler or claim concurrent close safe.

rows.decision: native join mechanics with lifecycle contract needing clarification
rows.evidence: For a started thread, duplicates a synchronization handle, alerts the original handle, waits and closes the duplicate. For !started returns success without starting or joining the suspended thread. C nt_remove_event_thread supplies nt_init_called and ignores the result.
rows.remaining: Document/resolve the unstarted-thread process-exit policy and retained handle ownership at C/F teardown before calling this a generic join. No behavior change or bug assertion from source inspection alone.

rows.evidence: Resolves NTDLL exports, adapts native IO_STATUS_BLOCK to original output form.
rows.boundary: No F provider. Full caller contract must ensure stack status lifetime for selected async-capable APIs; not established merely by this ownership read.

rows.decision: B native locale and allocation leaves
rows.evidence: Current native keyboard-layout code page and LocalAlloc/LocalFree pairing.
rows.boundary: Different from frontend-routed Console layout; do not merge those distinct authorities.

rows.evidence: Native heap/string/path/crypto bindings and private TLS TEB/PEB snapshot; no task completion or Run16 selection.
rows.boundary: Opaque TEB fields may hold C-owned data without transferring algorithm ownership. Snapshot teardown and imported/native symbol selection need caller verification, not new product session state.

rows.decision: B numeric mapping records and cleanup
rows.evidence: Owner-keyed host/page/alias tables, bounds checks and B cleanup registration; no CPU page walk or outer callbacks.
rows.boundary: Host context controls lifetime; existing production single-owner/concurrency preconditions remain. C owns actual machine translation semantics.

rows.evidence: Explicit buffer/capacity and native code page conversion only.
rows.boundary: No PIF launch selection or product lifecycle.

rows.evidence: I_BrowserServerEnumForXactsrv returns ERROR_CALL_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
rows.boundary: Original public branch remains C; no replacement browser protocol or claimed feature restoration.

rows.evidence: Three historical remote providers return ERROR_CALL_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no network/outer service implementation.
rows.boundary: Preserve original caller status handling. Absence of outward dependencies does not mean RAP implemented.

rows.evidence: Derives root from current image, validates relative suffixes, converts encoding and implements directory ABI.
rows.boundary: Owner explicitly admitted package layout knowledge to B; no request/worker selection.

rows.decision: split B thread mechanics from D/F lifecycle callbacks
rows.evidence: Validates entry ABI, invokes lifecycle capture/finish, delegates thread creation to A.
rows.boundary: D worker-thread bridge binds F session and WOW retirement hooks. Existing callback ledger records chain; do not move whole session retirement into B.

rows.decision: retain B explicit unavailable native-service boundary
rows.evidence: Returns STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every request and owns no task state or callback. This does not implement hardware VDM monitoring.
rows.remaining: Callers must retain their existing unsupported-service behavior; this file alone does not prove every caller handles that status.

rows.decision: split machine BOP and outer lifecycle policy
rows.evidence: Two-slot table; ClearInstanceDataMarking forwards to F controlled session termination.
rows.boundary: No success no-op or B cancellation policy; owning C failure/return boundary still requires design.

rows.evidence: Borrows system brushes, allocates one pattern brush once, publishes only after creation succeeds.
rows.boundary: Owned gray brush has process lifetime; do not replace it with per-task cleanup.

rows.evidence: CopyInflateRect operates only on explicit RECT values.
rows.boundary: No task, callback or machine state.

rows.evidence: _GetDlgItem traverses C PWND using REBASEPWND through control-client/precomp.h.
rows.boundary: Not independent B; preserve owner-approved exception, do not duplicate C layout.

rows.evidence: ANSI/Unicode GetWindowLong/SetWindowLong selected by explicit parameter; original C getset/dlgmgr callers.
rows.boundary: Caller owns dialog procedure and lifetime; these bodies do not dispatch a task.

rows.decision: B native font resources keyed by opaque owner
rows.evidence: Native GDI operations plus remote-font path/count records. C wgfont supplies CURRENTPTD as numeric key; wkman calls UnloadNetworkFonts at task cleanup.
rows.boundary: B does not interpret task identity or decide completion. Preserve load counts, native resource ownership and externally timed unload; allocation-failure behavior not newly validated.

rows.evidence: Locked process-local table converts WORD aliases, retires slots and reserves pseudo-brush indices; C walias macros call retire.
rows.boundary: B owns alias metadata, not native GDI object destruction or task completion. No independent session added.

rows.decision: B native thread-local hook ABI adaptation
rows.evidence: Checks callback module and same-process thread; delegates to native SetWindowsHookExA and preserves LastError.
rows.boundary: Native hook protocol accepts caller callbacks; this is not a private F service table. Caller retains unhook and code lifetime.

rows.evidence: GetIconInfo/GetObject; destroys returned bitmap resources; supports frame zero only.
rows.boundary: No private guest cursor layout, frontend choice or retained task state.

rows.evidence: Resolves twelve exports only from loaded GDI32/win32u; x86 ABI and text descriptor are explicit; rejects non-null system timer callback.
rows.boundary: Installed OS exports are not repository F providers. Existing private ABI evidence must remain; this ownership read is not renewed OS-version compatibility proof.

rows.evidence: IsGUIThread conversion and GetSystemInfo query with LastError preservation; no cached task connection.
rows.boundary: Original/current WOW task metadata remains outside this function.

rows.evidence: Read-only native machine compatibility view or current-user desktop key; absent key returns unavailable.

rows.evidence: Allocates page, starts periodic native publisher, signals/joins it and frees resources. F page_domain stops before unmapping and disposes later.
